svg.title: A design process in six sketches
svg.desc: Three interview bubbles take turns. As the conversation clears, two hand-drawn lightbulbs take shape in its place. A decision branches into two outcomes. Selecting a row on one screen updates the timeline on another. A pointer hovers over a card, selects it, and drags it past its neighbor to reorder the pair. A shared field has a hand-lettered spacing measurement. A chart marks a change in a metric.
